articles.title: Iran targeted US radar system in Bahrain
articles.summary: Iran claimed it struck US radar systems in Bahrain, while the US said it had intercepted the attacks. Clashes continue in the Strait of Hormuz, as the war remains in a state of de-escalation.

articles.title: IRGC says it targeted US early-warning radar in Bahrain after 'enemy attack' on telecom tower
Iran’s IRGC says it targeted US radar in Bahrain
articles.summary: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) announced that its forces targeted a US early-warning radar in Bahrain in retaliation to an attack on a telecommunications tower in Iran’s Sirik. "This serves as a serious warning to the aggressor enemy to cease its aerial provocations and oil smuggling in the Strait of Hormuz.
